writeReplies.note: YouTube v1 video update: PUT /youtube/v3/videos?part=snippet, status, recordingDetails with {id, snippet: {title, categoryId, description, tags}}. The template sets no category, so categoryId is sent empty; YouTube's docs require it when the snippet is updated, so the real API may refuse the update; the fixture answers success (assumed)

expect.offline: If Recent compares the entry's pubDate with n8n's wall clock (not frozen: README, Timezone), so the entries are dated in 2030 to count as posted in the last ten minutes whenever the bench runs; the Claude side's clock starts from n8n's startedAt, so it agrees. Wait is a parameterless Wait v1.1 (5 s) between status checks. The Apify token and channel id are template placeholders the overlay fills. Generate Description reads $json.subtitles[0].srt, which fails on null subtitles in n8n
